author: reek
body: Probe (closed by capability stage 1b): the raw block-device intrinsics now carry the Device.Block effect row, so a function with a pure signature can no longer read or write disk sectors. In an application/library quire the effect is enforced - the effectful call cannot hide in a plain let (CDX2033) and block-read-sector's effect is not declared in the signature (CDX2031). The owned hardware stack (compiler, kernel, boards, plugs) is quire-exempt; the foreword Fat16 reader declares [Device.Block] on its whole read path.
